title: Tion Medon
franchise: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
description: The tall, gaunt Pau'an Port Administrator on Utapau was the first to greet Obi-Wan Kenobi when he arrived seeking General Grievous in the final hours of the Clone Wars. Tion Medon was initially reluctant to reveal Grievous's location, but Kenobi convinced him and allowed him the use of a reptavian varactyl named Boga to hunt down the general of the Separatist army.
